tools.name: find_offices
tools.description: Find lie detector (polygraph) test offices near a place. Search by city, state/region, or country (United States, Canada, or United Kingdom). Returns each matching office with its address, all-inclusive prices, and a booking link.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get polygraph examination pricing for a location. Returns the all-inclusive price tiers (single person, couple/two-person total, and group per-examinee) and how payment works: there is no booking fee and nothing is paid online or to LieDetectorTest.com — the client pays the examiner directly once th

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Get general information about the lie detector test service: what is offered, how booking works, how payment works, the service area, and what happens after booking. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: Send a free, no-obligation lie detector test appointment request for a person, directly to the examiner who covers the chosen location. Nothing is paid online and there is no booking fee: the examiner contacts the person, agrees the date, payment and cancellation terms with them, and the person pays

tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Check the status of an existing booking or appointment request by its reference (e.g. LDT-2026072062783). Returns the status and location. Status "request" means the request has been sent to the examiner, who will contact the person directly.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_pricing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
